criterion.given: The platform is accessed for the first time

then.requirement: Rich, carefully curated color palette (Competitive Data theme: Deep Indigo #4f46e5 primary, Cyan #06b6d4 secondary, Purple #8b5cf6 accent)
High-quality images and visual assets that enhance the analytics experience
Comprehensive, beautiful iconography using Lucide React icons
Smooth, polished animations and transitions on interactive elements
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliant color contrast ratios (4.5:1 minimum for text)
Responsive design that adapts beautifully across screen sizes (mobile-first: 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px breakpoints)

criterion.given: All visual elements use the established design tokens from the UX Design Specification

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Interface uses modern, enticing, beautiful design (not minimalistic) with rich visual elements. System displays high-quality images and visual assets, smooth animations, carefully curated color palettes, comprehensive iconography, impressive layouts, and delightful micro-interactions.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: ShadCN/UI with New York style variant, installed via copy-paste model (not npm package) for full customization control. Built on Radix UI primitives ensuring accessibility (WCAG 2.1 Level AA).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with utility-first approach, custom theme matching UX Design Specification. CSS variables for theming with light/dark mode support.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: ShadCN/UI (New York style) with copy-paste components for full customization control. Competitive Data theme with Deep Indigo #4f46e5 primary, Cyan #06b6d4 secondary, Purple #8b5cf6 accent. Responsive breakpoints: 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Competitive Data theme: Primary #4f46e5 (Deep Indigo), Secondary #06b6d4 (Cyan), Accent #8b5cf6 (Purple). All colors meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 minimum for text).

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story acceptance criteria and technical notes for visual design system implementation. References UX Design Specification sections 1.1, 3.1 (Color System), 3.2 (Typography).

package.name: @radix-ui/react-*
package.reason: Radix UI primitives used by ShadCN/UI components

constraints.constraint: Component Library: Use ShadCN/UI with New York style variant, installed via copy-paste model (not npm package) for full customization control
Styling Approach: Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with utility-first approach, custom theme matching UX Design Specification
Theme System: CSS variables for theming with light/dark mode support, managed via theme provider component
Responsive Design: Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px
Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text
Animation Library: Use Tailwind transitions or Framer Motion for smooth animations, respect prefers-reduced-motion
Test Coverage: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code
TDD Approach: Write tests before implementation, follow Red-Green-Refactor cycle

interface.name: ThemeProvider
interface.description: Theme context provider for light/dark mode switching. Provides theme state and toggle functionality.

interface.name: useTheme
interface.description: Hook to access theme context. Returns theme, setTheme, toggleTheme, isDark, isLight.

interface.name: Tailwind Config
interface.signature: export default { darkMode, content, theme: { extend: { colors, borderRadius, keyframes, animation } } }
interface.description: Tailwind CSS configuration. Needs custom color tokens and breakpoints added to theme.extend.

interface.name: CSS Variables
interface.description: CSS custom properties for theming. Defined in :root and .dark selectors. Needs Competitive Data theme colors.

tests.standards: Test Coverage: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Test Types: Unit tests for components, integration tests for theme switching, accessibility tests using axe-core. TDD Approach: Write tests before implementation, follow Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Accessibility Testing: Use @axe-core/playwright for E2E accessibility testing, verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

idea.description: Test Tailwind config compilation: Verify tailwind.config.mjs compiles without errors and generates expected CSS classes
Test color token accessibility: Verify all color combinations meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios (4.5:1 minimum) using automated tools
Test responsive breakpoints: Verify layouts adapt correctly at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px using viewport testing
Test ShadCN/UI components: Verify all base components render correctly with custom theme and are accessible (keyboard navigation, screen readers)
Test theme switching: Verify light/dark mode switching works correctly, theme persists across page reloads, and CSS variables update properly
Test animations: Verify animations are smooth (60fps), performant, and respect prefers-reduced-motion media query
Test design token compliance: Verify all visual elements use design tokens from UX Design Specification (colors, spacing, typography)
Test icon system: Verify Lucide React icons render correctly across all screen sizes and have proper ARIA labels for accessibility
